title: Dynamic skills-driven capacity allocator and contingency lane protocol for cycle microbursts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a lightweight, repeatable protocol that allocates engineers to short-lived microtranches during high-risk windows (microbursts) based on explicit skill signals, and a formal contingency lane that preserves critical work while enabling rapid rebalancing. This ticket scopes the PM plan, acceptance criteria, rollout steps, and metrics for a pilot across two initiatives.
background: Recent cycles experienced unpredictable microbursts (hot fixes, infra incidents, last-minute compliance asks) that repeatedly disrupted committed scope. Current responses are ad-hoc: volunteers, manager reassignments, or scope deferrals without a consistent rubric. We need a predictable way to reserve and route a small fraction of team capacity responsive to skill signals and severity, while keeping visibility and minimizing context-switch cost.
goals: Define a skills-signal taxonomy (primary skill, secondary, on-call familiarity) to drive rapid microtranche assignment
Design a 10% contingency lane protocol that can be invoked and staffed in <=48 hours
Create a triage rubric for deciding when to invoke microtranches vs. scope cut
Pilot the protocol on two cross-functional initiatives and measure impact on scope slippage and incident MTTR
scope: Policy for contingency lane creation and decommissioning
Skill-signal matrix schema and engineering onboarding checklist
Rotation/compensation guidance for staff pulled into microtranches
A lightweight dashboard view in Console MVP showing contingency allocations per cycle
out_of_scope: Full automation of rostering via HR systems (manual triage for pilot)
Permanent headcount changes or hiring decisions
Major Console UX redesigns beyond an MVP tile
acceptance_criteria: Contingency lane policy documented and approved by Eng + People
Skill-signal taxonomy defined and used in at least one staffing decision
Pilot executed on two initiatives with postmortem documenting at least three learnings
Dashboard MVP implemented to display: reserved capacity %, current microtranches, and owners
tasks: Draft initial policy and review w/ Eng managers (owner: PM)
Survey engineers for self-reported skills & on-call familiarity (owner: People Ops)
Build skills-signal CSV and ingestion process for pilot (owner: Platform Eng)
Implement Console MVP tile (owner: Console UX)
Run pilot on Initiative A and Initiative B (owners: Initiative PMs)
Collect metrics and run post-pilot retro and decision session (owner: PM)
Publish playbook and onboarding doc (owner: PM + Docs)
Decide next steps (scale, iterate, or retire) after retro
rollout_plan: Week 0: Align stakeholders; finalize policy draft and pilot success metrics
Week 1: Run engineer skills survey; Platform Eng prepares ingestion; Console UX starts tile
Week 2-4: Pilot active — contingency lane available; track invocations and staffing latency
Week 5: Postmortem, quantify scope saved, context-switch cost, and engineer sentiment
Week 6: Publish playbook and recommended cycle guardrails for next planning cycle
metrics: Scope slippage % for initiatives with invoked contingency lane vs. control group
Average time to staff a microtranche (hours) from invocation
Engineer context-switch cost: median lost productive hours per pulled engineer (self-report)
Number of unplanned hotfixes handled without deferring planned scope
Stakeholder satisfaction score (PM/Eng lead) after pilot
risks_mitigations: Risk: Moral hazard—teams rely on contingency and under-plan. Mitigation: limit invocations to 2 per initiative and require PM+Eng lead justification
Risk: Burnout for engineers pulled into microtranches. Mitigation: rotation rules, comp/time-off guidance, and skip-lists for recently overloaded contributors
Risk: Poor skill data accuracy. Mitigation: short survey + manager verification and explicit 'familiarity' flags
Risk: Console tile adds maintenance cost. Mitigation: MVP read-only view with CSV import; iterate only if pilot shows value

estimate_rationale: Estimate 5 points covers PM time for stakeholder alignment, coordination with People Ops, a minimal Console tile, and running two pilots; assumes Platform Eng provides a simple CSV ingestion hook.
implementation_notes: Keep Console tile read-only and backed by a CSV for the pilot to avoid backend schema churn
Use existing cycle cadence and labels to flag initiatives eligible for contingency invocation
Track invocations as a discrete event type in cycle analytics to correlate with scope outcomes
